description: Stock team on your own Claude Code: every skill off; the lead carries the stock lead's tool floor, while the hand runs with 35 tools off (plan mode, web, task and cron among them) and adds the clodex-locate and clodex-redproof agents to the built-in ones; costs more per ticket than the clodex kit.

lead.brief: team lead; holds durable context, dispatches specs, verifies and integrates the work.

hand.brief: implementer; executes a spec to done, one distilled report per task.

scout.brief: lookup scout on Haiku; verifies file:line coordinates, call sites and test pins at a named commit and writes one table; edits nothing, decides nothing.

page-scout.brief: page scout on Haiku; projects one saved web-page snapshot onto a ticket's question and writes one file of verbatim cells with line provenance, coverage and notices; Read and Write only, never the browser, edits nothing.

reviewer.brief: reviewer; an independent verification pass, invoked on demand.
